serve: docker compose --profile sourcebot up -d sourcebot sourcebot-postgres sourcebot-redis sourcebot-mcp sourcebot-proxy

index.ready: curl -fsS http://localhost:4330/api/repos | python3 -c "import sys,json; r=[x for x in json.load(sys.stdin) if x['repoName'].endswith('/lab/{repo}')]; sys.exit(0 if r and r[0].get('indexedAt') else 1)"

stop: docker compose stop sourcebot sourcebot-mcp sourcebot-proxy sourcebot-postgres sourcebot-redis
